sources.note: Open Beauty Facts, ODbL — crowd-sourced from pack scans. Ingredients in declared order.
Open Beauty Facts bulk export, matched by barcode. ODbL, the same licence this dataset carries. The earlier import took the name and little else; this reads the pack fields it left behind.

Read from the page's own labelled fields, never from its marketing copy. No price or availability is taken.
